newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish president amends new constitution.
newsitem.headline: Polish president amends new constitution.

text.p: Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski on Monday proposed 30 amendments to the country's constitution, which the National Assembly passed on Saturday, PAP news agency said.

They include limiting the parliamentary immunity of deputies, making rulings of the Constitutional Tribunal final and expanding the president's prerogatives as commander-in-chief of the armed forces, the agency said.
The National Assembly is due to vote on the changes on April 2.
Kwasniewski returned to Poland from Brussels on Monday to discuss the changes with Polish parliamentary leaders before leaving on an official visit to Ireland.

The non-parliamentary opposition opposes the new constitution, overwhelmingly passed by the post-communist- dominated assembly, and are calling on Poles to reject it in a referendum likely to be held in May.
